module_summary: AXI4-lite protocol firewall: skid-buffered pass-through channels with upstream/downstream outstanding counters and stall/ack timeout timers detect slave faults, then return SLVERR and reset the downstream bus.

anchors.name: o_write_fault
anchors.why: Sticky write-fault flag; forces error responses and downstream reset on write misbehavior.

anchors.name: o_read_fault
anchors.why: Sticky read-fault flag; forces error responses and downstream reset on read misbehavior.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Downstream write-address valid, suppressed when a write fault is active.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Downstream read-address valid, suppressed when a read fault is active.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write response valid, from downstream or synthesized on fault.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read response valid, from downstream or synthesized on fault.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Upstream write-address request entering the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Upstream read-address request entering the AR skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data returned upstream, zeroed on fault or downstream reset.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data forwarded downstream from the W skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response upstream, forced SLVERR on fault or EXOKAY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Read response upstream, forced SLVERR on fault or EXOKAY.

anchors.name: awskd_ready
anchors.why: Accepts AW from skid buffer: downstream space normally, counter balance during fault.

anchors.name: wskd_ready
anchors.why: Accepts W from skid buffer: downstream space normally, counter balance during fault.

anchors.name: arskd_ready
anchors.why: Accepts AR from skid buffer: downstream space normally, drains on fault.

anchors.name: aw_count
anchors.why: Upstream outstanding write-address count; produces aw_zero/aw_full.

anchors.name: w_count
anchors.why: Upstream outstanding write-data count; produces w_zero/w_full.

anchors.name: r_count
anchors.why: Upstream outstanding read count; produces r_zero/r_full.

anchors.name: aw_zero
anchors.why: No outstanding AW; gates fault-mode responses and downstream reset release.

anchors.name: w_zero
anchors.why: No outstanding W; gates fault-mode responses and reset release.

anchors.name: r_zero
anchors.why: No outstanding reads; gates fault-mode read responses.

anchors.name: aw_full
anchors.why: AW counter full; blocks awskd_ready.

anchors.name: w_full
anchors.why: W counter full; blocks wskd_ready.

anchors.name: r_full
anchors.why: Read counter full; blocks arskd_ready.

anchors.name: aw_w_greater
anchors.why: More AW than W accepted; lets W drain during fault, masks AW stall.

anchors.name: w_aw_greater
anchors.why: More W than AW accepted; lets AW drain during fault.

anchors.name: downstream_aw_count
anchors.why: Downstream outstanding AW count used to validate B responses.

anchors.name: downstream_w_count
anchors.why: Downstream outstanding W count used to validate B responses.

anchors.name: downstream_r_count
anchors.why: Downstream outstanding read count used to validate R responses.

anchors.name: downstream_aw_zero
anchors.why: No downstream AW outstanding; unsolicited B triggers write fault.

anchors.name: downstream_w_zero
anchors.why: No downstream W outstanding; unsolicited B triggers write fault.

anchors.name: downstream_r_zero
anchors.why: No downstream reads outstanding; unsolicited R triggers read fault.

anchors.name: aw_stall_counter
anchors.why: Timeout counter for downstream stalling the write address channel.

anchors.name: w_stall_counter
anchors.why: Timeout counter for downstream stalling the write data channel.

anchors.name: w_ack_timer
anchors.why: Timeout counter waiting for downstream write acknowledgment.

anchors.name: r_stall_counter
anchors.why: Timeout counter for downstream stalling the read address channel.

anchors.name: r_ack_timer
anchors.why: Timeout counter waiting for downstream read data.

anchors.name: aw_stall_limit
anchors.why: AW stall timeout reached; sets write fault.

anchors.name: w_stall_limit
anchors.why: W stall timeout reached; sets write fault.

anchors.name: w_ack_limit
anchors.why: Write ack timeout reached; sets write fault.

anchors.name: r_stall_limit
anchors.why: AR stall timeout reached; sets read fault.

anchors.name: r_ack_limit
anchors.why: Read ack timeout reached; sets read fault.

anchors.name: last_bchanged
anchors.why: BRESP changed while stalled; sets write fault.

anchors.name: last_rchanged
anchors.why: R data/resp changed while stalled; sets read fault.

anchors.name: last_bdata
anchors.why: Previous BRESP held to detect changes during stall.

anchors.name: last_rdata
anchors.why: Previous RRESP/RDATA held to detect changes during stall.

anchors.name: bskd_valid
anchors.why: Downstream B response valid out of B skid buffer; checked for faults.

anchors.name: rskd_valid
anchors.why: Downstream R response valid out of R skid buffer; checked for faults.

anchors.name: bskd_resp
anchors.why: Buffered downstream BRESP; EXOKAY flags a fault.

anchors.name: rskd_resp
anchors.why: Buffered downstream RRESP; EXOKAY flags a fault.

anchors.name: SELF_RESET_GENERATION.MIN_RESET.reset_counter
anchors.why: Enforces minimum downstream reset duration before release.

groups.name: write_channels
groups.description: AW/W skid buffers forwarding requests downstream, gated by fault and counter state.

groups.name: write_response
groups.description: B skid buffer returning downstream responses or synthesized SLVERR upstream.

groups.name: read_channels
groups.description: AR and R skid buffers forwarding reads and returning data or errors.

groups.name: transaction_counters
groups.description: Upstream and downstream outstanding counters with zero/full and AW-W balance flags.

groups.name: timeout_timers
groups.description: Stall and acknowledgment timeout counters raising limit flags for fault detection.

groups.name: fault_detector
groups.description: Sets sticky read/write faults on timeouts, unsolicited, EXOKAY or unstable responses.

groups.name: self_reset
groups.description: Holds downstream reset on fault until idle and minimum reset duration elapsed.
